claim: In games that move figures in whole cells every few frames, make motion smooth by gliding each sprite part of the way each frame, not by changing resolution.
limit: Collisions stay cell-based, so a gliding sprite may look closer than the game counts.

evidence.text: Build uses filled whole-figure sprites that glide; the recording averages 4.35 frames per update (28% 3, 34% 4, 22% 5).
evidence.quote: The recording averages 4.35 frames per update (28% 3, 34% 4, 22% 5);
